excluded_gold.title: The Check operation exhibits asymmetric cache trust logic: cached permission grants are trusted and returned immediately
excluded_gold.description: The Check operation exhibits asymmetric cache trust logic: cached permission grants are trusted and returned immediately, but cached denials from the same permission cache are ignored, leading to a fresh database lookup. This allows stale cached grants to provide access to revoked resources, posing a security risk.

adjudication.why: Cached grants were already trusted in getUserPermissions/getAnonymousPermissions. The new path refreshes a denial from the permission map, while the separate permission-denial cache explicitly short-circuits to false; the label does not establish a new stale-grant regression.

excluded_gold.title: The test comment says the cached permissions 'allow access', but the map stores false for dashboards:uid:dash1, so check
excluded_gold.description: The test comment says the cached permissions 'allow access', but the map stores false for dashboards:uid:dash1, so checkPermission will still treat this scope as not allowed.

adjudication.why: The false-valued test seed does not exercise the intended cached-grant override. This is a coverage-only gold item, not a production behavior defect; review excludes missing test coverage. The old candidate did surface it.

promotion_candidates.title: Denial cache key omits identity type — anonymous:0 and render:0 collide
promotion_candidates.description: Denial cache key lacks identity type field. Anonymous users and render service both get identifier "0", causing cache collisions. Anonymous denied dashboards:read poisons render service's read check within 30s, breaking image rendering for restricted dashboards; reverse also holds for write.

promotion_candidates.title: Should deny on explicit cache deny entry passes with the denial cache removed
promotion_candidates.description: Test seeded scope map has false values that grant nothing, not the true values needed to test the cache deny short-circuit. Test passes even with denial cache removed, so Check's denial cache short-circuit at service.go:117 is untested.

promotion_candidates.description: cacheHit field is false in both remaining test cases; seeding block (lines 367–369) and assertion (lines 388–390) are unreachable. Cached path is no longer tested but future readers will assume it is.
